patch_description: The best prior programs reached makespan 261 by combining: (1) cheap, diverse full-lookahead greedy constructions (randomized tie-breaking, sampled candidate sets), (2) a diversity-preserving depth-adaptive beam search (top width-2 by cost plus 2 children with differing last transactions, avoiding prefix collapse), (3) simulated annealing with greedy insertion intensification on the top candidates, and (4) an LNS ruin-and-recreate phase on the incumbent. I combine all four phases with a 28s budget split roughly 15% greedy, 50% beam, 75% SA, and the remainder LNS. The greedy phase provides diverse, cheap seeds whose diversity drives beam and SA success; beam search with diversity-preserving pruning avoids converging on identical prefixes; SA with insertion sweeps escapes local optima; LNS block reinsertion provides large-neighborhood improvements. All moves are evaluated by actual makespan via get_opt_seq_cost, per the task guidance that heuristics like length/write-count don't correlate with makespan.
